title: ToolDescriptor
description: Owned, JSON-serializable tool descriptor matching `schemas/tools.v1.json` and `ashift tools --json`.

output_formats.description:
Optional list of all allowed output format identifiers when a tool can emit more than one
format (e.g. `["png", "jpeg", "webp", "tiff", "bmp", "zip"]`). When omitted or empty,
[`Self::output_format`] is the sole allowed format.

date.description: Optional date string rendered with signature.

flatten.description:
Whether to flatten the visual signature directly into the page content stream
instead of keeping it as a stamp annotation. Default is `true`.

image_data.description: Base64 encoded image data or image filename (when mode = `image`).

page.description: 1-based page number where the visual signature appears (default: 1).

rect.description: Bounding rectangle `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` in points (PDF coordinates, origin bottom-left).

signer_name.description: Optional signer name / label rendered underneath signature.

vector_data.description: SVG path data or vector stroke coordinates (when mode = `draw`).

SignVisualMode.description: Mode of visual signature appearance: `type`, `draw`, or `image`.

oneOf.description: Render typographic text with optional signer details.
Render hand-drawn vector stroke or SVG path.

tools.summary: Add a visual signature (drawn stroke, typed text, or image stamp) to a PDF page.

certificate.description: PKCS#12 certificate file path, handle, or base64 data (secret).

key_password.description: Passphrase to unlock the private key if separate from container password (secret).

level.description: Conformance level (B-B, B-T, B-LT, B-LTA). Default is `B-B`.

location.description: Location where the document was signed.

password.description: Passphrase to decrypt the PKCS#12 certificate container (secret).

tsa_url.description: RFC 3161 Timestamp Authority (TSA) URL. Required for B-T, B-LT, B-LTA.

identity.description: Common name or SHA-1 fingerprint of the signing certificate in the Keychain.

crl_files.description: Optional paths to pre-fetched CRL (Certificate Revocation List) files.

ocsp_responses.description: Optional paths to pre-fetched OCSP response files.

timestamp_token.description: Optional path to a pre-fetched RFC 3161 timestamp response token file.

trust_anchors.description: Optional paths to trusted root CA certificates (PEM/DER format).

oneOf.description: PAdES B-T: signature with a trusted RFC 3161 timestamp.
PAdES B-LT: signature with Long-Term validation data (certificates and revocation info).
PAdES B-LTA: signature with Long-Term validation data and archival timestamp.

module.description: Path to the PKCS#11 module dynamic library (`.so` / `.dylib` / `.dll`).

slot.description: Optional slot number or token label.

VisibleSignature.description: Visual appearance settings for a digital signature.

appearance.description: Optional appearance text or template to render inside the signature box.

page.description: 1-based page number where the signature will appear.

rect.description: Bounding rectangle `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` in PDF user space units (points).
